definitionZh: 清晰的 CSS 属性设定一个元素是否必须移动到它之前的(已清除)浮动元素下面 。 清晰的财产适用于浮动和非浮动的元素.
sourceDefinition: The clear CSS property sets whether an element must be moved below (cleared) floating elements that precede it. The clear property applies to floating and non-floating elements.
